description: Source code for a GTK-based Flutter Linux application, defining the application class, activation, startup, shutdown, and command line handling.

classes.name: MyApplication
classes.description: Custom GTK application class integrating Flutter engine, managing application lifecycle and UI setup.

methods.name: my_application_activate
methods.description: Handles application activation, creates main window, sets header or title bar, initializes Flutter view, and registers plugins.

methods.name: my_application_local_command_line
methods.description: Processes command line arguments, registers application, and triggers activation.

methods.name: my_application_startup
methods.description: Performs startup routines, calls parent startup.

methods.name: my_application_shutdown
methods.description: Performs shutdown routines, calls parent shutdown.

methods.name: my_application_dispose
methods.description: Cleans up resources, especially freeing argument list.

methods.name: my_application_class_init
methods.description: Initializes class methods for application lifecycle.

methods.name: my_application_new
methods.description: Creates a new instance of MyApplication, sets program name and application ID.
